newsitem.title: TURKEY: TURKEY APPOINTS NEW TREASURY CHIEF.
newsitem.headline: TURKEY APPOINTS NEW TREASURY CHIEF.

text.p: Turkey appointed a new undersecretary on Wednesday for the treasury, the official gazette said.
Mahfi Egilmez, a former senior treasury offical who resigned in 1995, has been appointed as the new undersecretary to replace former chief Mehmet Kaytaz.

Prime Minister Mesut Yilmaz's left-right coalition government which won a key parliamentary confidence vote on Saturday is expected to change many senior officials at other state institutions and banks.
